data.title: Pattarapon seals first TDT victory in 3-way playoff
data.description: Pattarapon Losathapornpipit won the one-million-baht Singha–SAT TDT Nakhon Nayok 2026 in a three-way playoff at the par-71 Royal Hill Golf Resort & Spa in Nakhon Nayok on Friday.

data.title: Driver injures 20 kids
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Police have charged a 54-year-old driver with five offences after his car crashed into a child development centre in Muang district, injuring 20 children.

data.title: Amlo eyes 200 in exam fraud probe
data.description: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.

data.title: Thai InterPride head urges global solidarity
data.description: InterPride's first Thai transgender co-president has warned that global LGBTQ+ rights are at a critical crossroads, urging solidarity against rising hatred.

data.title: Hospital graft claims 'unproven'
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.

data.title: Na Ladprao beer hall owner charged over fatal fire
data.description: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.

data.title: Court halts delay of Social Security poll
data.description: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.

data.title: Down with the death penalty?
data.description: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.

data.title: No signs of bullying: witness
data.description: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: TH-AI Passport launch clears final hurdle
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society expects to launch the TH-AI Passport programme by Sept 1, after the Office of the Attorney General cleared the final legal hurdle for the nationwide AI initiative.

data.title: Thailand rejects UN envoy's report on Cambodia
data.description: Thailand has expressed deep disappointment with a recent United Nations report on Cambodia that criticised Thailand, saying it exceeded its mandate and lacked balance.

data.title: Govt speeds up rooftop solar scheme
data.description: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.

data.title: Lionel Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Jorge Messi, the father and agent of Lionel Messi, has died aged 68, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner's childhood club Newell's Old Boys announced on Saturday.

data.title: Infantino denies allegations of affair, favouritism while at UEFA: report
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino, who has endured a week of scathing criticism revolving around the now shelved private investment plan, has been accused by a British newspaper of paying off an alleged lover while at UEFA.

data.title: Ukraine denies targeting Bulgaria as drone explodes near pipeline
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Ukraine on Saturday denied targeting Bulgaria after a drone exploded close to the strategic Trans-Balkan gas pipeline linking Turkey to Ukraine near the Romanian border.

data.title: Bodies spotted on Nepal peak where five climbers went missing
data.description: KATHMANDU - ⁠Nepali rescue workers ​have spotted five bodies at a site where ​the same number of ‌climbers went missing last year, officials said on Saturday.

data.title: Drone explodes near gas pipeline in Bulgaria
data.description: SOFIA, Bulgaria - A drone that entered Bulgaria on Saturday exploded near the Romanian border and the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline there, which links Turkey to Ukraine, Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev announced.

data.title: Arsenal sign midfielder Guimaraes from Newcastle
data.description: LONDON - Premier League champions Arsenal have completed the signing of Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes for a reported fee of £75 million ($101 million), the two clubs announced Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil coach cries ‘robbery’ as Suakim admits ‘fluke’ knockdown
data.description: Nabil Anane’s coach Mehdi Zatout has branded the former champion’s split-decision loss to Suakim Pongsuphan PK a “robbery” – as the Thai veteran opened the door to a rematch.

data.title: Nene Royal’s ‘Hysteria’ tops 1 million views
data.description: Thai rocker Nene Royal’s latest performance on ”America’s Got Talent” — a rendition of Muse’s “Hysteria” — has surpassed one million views online within just 14 hours of its release.

data.title: Trump’s ex-lawyer confirmed as US attorney general
data.description: WASHINGTON - The US Senate confirmed President Donald Trump’s former personal lawyer Todd Blanche as attorney general early Saturday after Republican lawmakers shrugged off Democratic concerns over politicisation of the Department of Justice.

data.title: Bullies at elite Bangkok private school face charges
data.description: Police in Bangkok have charged a group of students from Saint Gabriel’s College, one of the country’s most prestigious private schools, after they were seen threatening and hitting another boy with an airsoft gun.

data.title: Police hope witnesses can shed light on school shooting
data.description: Police are stepping up their investigation into the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, questioning teachers, students and witnesses as they seek to determine what motivated a 14-year-old boy to kill seven people before taking his own life on Friday.

data.title: Tibet conference in Nepal pushed online
data.description: KATHMANDU - An international academic conference on Tibet due to take place in Nepal this month has been pushed online, organisers said on Saturday, calling it a ”worrying development”.

data.title: Thailand's 15 UNESCO Treasures
data.description: Recent global recognition of Thailand’s cultural treasures celebrates the nation's newest landmark on the international stage. This week on TheDisclosed, we examine Thailand's latest UNESCO listing and what lies ahead for future nominees.

data.title: Zelensky visits Russian ally Serbia for talks
data.description: BELGRADE - President Volodymyr Zelensky was making his first official visit to Serbia — a rare European country still closely aligned with Moscow — on Saturday as Ukraine seeks to bolster international support in the face of intensifying Russian strikes.

data.title: The 12 mythical giants watch over Suvarnabhumi Airport
data.description: Travellers navigating the bustling halls of Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport are greeted not just by modern terminal architecture, but by 12 towering, colour-splashed giants clad in golden armour.

data.title: Doctors Urge Tax Hikes on Unhealthy Goods as Youth NCD Risks Soar
data.description: Medical experts warn non-communicable diseases cost Thailand 1.6 trillion baht annually, urging urgent health tax reforms to protect young people

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin hits Okinawa, China shuts ports
data.description: TOKYO - Typhoon Dolphin lashed southern Okinawa prefecture in Japan on Saturday, injuring five people and cutting power to 14,000 buildings, while China shut ports and ferry routes ahead of the storm’s expected arrival on its east coast.
